```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results='asis'}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(psych350lab)
library(psych350data)
library(dplyr)
library(webexercises)
library(tinytable)
library(psych350lab)
library(psych350data)
library(dplyr)

data(superman, package = "psych350data")
superman <- prep_data(superman, "superman")

# Walk-through: year > 1975
walkthrough_data <- superman |>
  filter(year > 1975)

walkthrough_vars <- c("num", "year", "clark_height", "lois_height",
                      "clark_height_in", "lois_height_in", "height_diff",
                      "type", "clark_grp", "height_gap")

summary_stats_walkthrough <- compute_summary_stats(
  walkthrough_data |> select(all_of(walkthrough_vars))
)

# Take-home: rt_critics_count >= 5
takehome_vars <- c("rt_critics_score", "rt_critics_count",
                   "rt_audience_score", "rt_audience_count",
                   "ldb_likes", "ldb_scores",
                   "rt_avg", "rt_diff", "tomatometer", "popular")

takehome_data <- superman |>
  filter(rt_critics_count >= 5)

summary_stats_takehome <- compute_summary_stats(
  takehome_data |> select(all_of(takehome_vars))
)

# Wrap into list format expected by create_descriptives_checker
walkthrough_results <- list(Descriptives = summary_stats_walkthrough)
takehome_results    <- list(Descriptives = summary_stats_takehome)
```

## Homework checker
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat("\n**How to use the Homework Checker!**\n\n")
cat("1. Type your answer into each blank box. Round to 2 decimal places where appropriate. \n")
cat("2. Select your choice from the dropdown menu for interpretability\n")
cat("3. The box will turn **green** if your answer is correct\n")
cat("4. The box will turn **red** if your answer is incorrect - try again!\n")
cat("5. For this practice question, try entering the values shown below to see the green check marks\n\n")
cat("##### Here is a practice question to help you understand how to use the answer checker:\n\n")
cat("**Example Variable:** sample_var\n\n")
cat("*Mean: 5.25, SD: 2.1, SEM: 0.66*")
cat("\n\n")
cat("Mean: ", fitb(5.25), " | ")
cat("SD: ", fitb(2.10), " | ")
cat("SEM: ", fitb(0.66), "\n\n")
cat("**Is the mean interpretable?** ")
cat(mcq(c(
  "No - this is a label, not a variable",
  answer = "Yes - this is a quantitative variable",
  "Yes - this is a binary variable",
  "No - this is a multiple-category variable"
)))
```
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat("\n## **Walk-through Answers**\n\n")
cat("Enter the mean, standard deviation, sample size, and standard error for each variable:\n\n")

create_descriptives_checker(
  vars              = walkthrough_vars,
  desc_results_list = walkthrough_results,
  label             = "num",
  quantitative      = c("year", "clark_height", "lois_height",
                        "clark_height_in", "lois_height_in", "height_diff"),
  binary            = "clark_grp",
  multi_category    = c("type", "height_gap")
)
```
```{r}
#| results: asis

cat("Enter the mean, standard deviation, sample size, and standard error for each variable:\n\n")

                        "rt_audience_score", "rt_audience_count",
                        "ldb_likes", "ldb_scores", "rt_avg", "rt_diff"),
  binary            = "tomatometer",
  multi_category    = "popular"
)
```
